record.limits_note: DEAD AS OF 19 OCTOBER 2026. The Solstice upgrade (nv29, FIP-0118) ended Fil+ and DataCap outright: 'No new DataCap is minted, unused balances become inert, pending allocations can no longer be claimed, and the verified registry and DataCap actors refuse any state change.' Every new sector now gets 10x power regardless of content, so there is no longer any reason for an SP to accept free client data. Any 2025-era guide recommending Fil+ as free 20 TiB storage is now wrong.
record.reliability_note: Pending DataCap allocations became unusable at activation; unclaimed allocations are simply lost.
